summary: guarded sessions on the same repository can delete the live factory's control and ledger checkout entries from the shared .git/worktrees, which leaves the factory checkouts with a dangling .git and stalls the run after the first worker
evidence: 2026-10-18 09:29 queue of wrk-d025f96596783f91: .git/worktrees/control and .git/worktrees/glimmervoid-Ub06zL vanished minutes after creation while both checkouts still exist; git in them fails with 'gitfile does not point to a valid repository'; worker commit 2c9ce479 never got a close-out. Guarded session policy denyRead /home/jwaters/.glimmervoid while the shared .git stays writable, so a git worktree prune there (Claude Code worktree cleanup ships one) sees the factory checkouts as missing. Direct worktree add/remove/list/status do not prune (scratch repro, git 2.39.5).
